description: Use when an agent needs the weather anywhere in the world. Input: lat, lon, optional hours (0-72 hourly steps, default 24), tz (IANA zone for daily summaries, default UTC). Output: JSON current temperature, symbol, wind, humidity, cloud, pressure; hourly series; daily min/max, precipitation, max wind, symbol for ~10 days. Data: MET Norway. Example: ?lat=51.5072&lon=-0.1276&tz=Europe/London Price: $0.002 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

tz.description: IANA time zone for daily summaries and local hours (default UTC)

name: weather_global
title: Worldwide weather forecast: current, hourly (72 h) and 10-day daily for any coordinates
